seed: New Window opens the front door ui-entry-wt.html draws (steps 2 to 5), at Next defaults with no switch changed: Open and the primary button in the title bar, the prompt bar, four templates under Start a project, and Recent. Clicking the Design UI tile by pointer renames the primary button New UI canvas (the step finds the button by those words, so a tile that failed to rename it fails here); clicking that by pointer opens untitled-ui in an editor window of its own, the window goes into the Design mode, and the front door closes on its own. The front door is photographed in light mode, so its words are read against the light window; design-ui-start-walk photographs it in the system's own appearance. Then a second front door with nothing picked: New canvas puts up the size sheet, Create opens a blank canvas in its own window, and that front door closes too.

steps.note: The editor the front door opened: untitled-ui, 1280 by 800, the Login starter frame on the canvas, the Library on Components, and the mode chip reading Design. The front door is gone.
With no template picked the primary button reads New canvas; it puts up the size sheet over the front door, and Create opens the blank canvas in a window of its own while the front door closes.
